cards.title: Multi-Agent System on a Cloud VPS
cards.subtitle: Cloud VPS Orchestration
cards.plainText: Runs his own multi-agent system (Hermes Agent) on a cloud VPS: specialist agents (finance, career, academics, outreach drafting, infra, cleanup) orchestrated via Discord and Telegram with human approval gates.
bullets: Multi-agent topology: specialist profiles for finance, career, academics, outreach drafting, infrastructure, and cleanup.
Orchestration channels: connected live through Discord and Telegram bots with human approval gates for critical actions.
Self-improving runtime: persistent memory database, autonomous tool search, and scheduled maintenance tasks.
cards.closingNote: Lately he builds small agents like these for other people's chores too.
